results.quote: Then, there exist a finite circuit depth \(L\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}\), parameter vectors \(\beta,\gamma\in\mathbb{R}^L\), a normalized ground state \(|\zeta\rangle\in H_{P,\mathrm{min}}\), and a global phase \(\phi\in\mathbb{R}\) such that \(U_L(\beta,\gamma)|\xi\rangle=|\zeta\rangle,\)
every \(g\in U_{I,\varphi_\mathfrak{g}}\) can be represented using at most \(\mathcal{T}_\mathbf{a}:=\sum_{j=1}^{\mathcal{D}_\mathbf{a}}(2j-1)c_j\) native exponential factors.

There exists a neighborhood \(\mathcal{V}_{[\psi]}\) of the ray \([\psi]\) in the projective state orbit \(\mathcal{O}_{[\psi]}\) such that every state \(|\zeta\rangle\) with \([\zeta]\in\mathcal{V}_{[\psi]}\) admits a finite product-of-exponentials realization \(|\zeta\rangle=e^{i\phi} U_L(\theta)|\psi\rangle=e^{i\phi} e^{\theta_La_{j_L}}\cdots e^{\theta_1a_{j_1}}|\psi\rangle,\) where \(\phi\in[0,2\pi]\), \(a_{j_s}\in\{a_1,\dots,a_k\}\) for each \(s\in\{1,\dots,L\}\), and the required depth \(L=\mathcal{T}_{\mathbf{a},\psi}\) satisfies (51).

The stabilization depth of the corresponding free dynamical Lie algebras satisfy \(\mathcal{D}_{\mathfrak{g}_{P_n,\mathrm{free}}}\le 2n-1(n\ge 2),\mathcal{D}_{\mathfrak{g}_{C_n,\mathrm{free}}}\le 2n-1(n\ge 3),\mathcal{D}_{\mathfrak{g}_{K_n,\mathrm{free}}}\le 2n-1(n\ge 2).\)

results.problem: Global unitary synthesis on invariant sectors
results.quote: Any unitary operator _U_ on _V_ (or \(U\in\mathrm{SU}(V)\) when \(\mathfrak{g}\big|_V=\mathfrak{su}(D)\)) can be synthesized with a global depth _L_<sub>glob</sub> bounded by \(L_\mathrm{glob}\le\frac{D(D-1)}{2}\cdot\big(K_X+K_\mathrm{diag}\big)+K_\mathrm{diag}.\)

every projective unitary \([U]\in\mathrm{PU}(V)\) can be synthesized with a circuit of depth \(L_\mathrm{glob}^\mathrm{proj}\le\big(4^q-3\cdot 2^{q-1}\big)K_{1\mathrm{q}}+\big(\frac{3}{4}4^q-\frac{3}{2}2^q\big)K_\mathrm{CX}.\)

Any unitary operator _U_ on _W_ (or \(U\in\mathrm{SU}(W)\) when \(\mathfrak{g}\simeq\mathfrak{su}(W)\)) can be synthesized with a global depth _L_<sub>glob</sub> bounded by \(L_\mathrm{glob}\le 3(2\mathcal{D}_\mathbf{a}-1)\left(\frac{7}{4}\cdot 4^n-3\cdot 2^{n-1}\right).\)

Every unitary \(U\in\mathrm{U}(W_\mathcal{F})\) admits an exact native Flip-or-Stay pulse synthesis with total depth \(L_\mathrm{glob}(\Gamma)\) bounded by \(L_\mathrm{glob}(\Gamma)\le\Delta_\Gamma(D-1)(4D^2-3D+2)+2D^3-D^2.\)
